systems.country_label: Prévention des épidémies et système d'information sanitaire
systems.owner: Government of Congo, under the Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique financed by the European Investment Bank

note: The EIB financing contract ratified on 16 October 2025 lists a planned component for epidemic prevention and a health information system, described in the passage only as triggering the response to epidemics and building on existing DHIS2 initiatives; that is surveillance, and DHIS2 is named without any description of what it does, so no fact for hmis or emr.
